rivals.A: Repeated host serialization, copying or validation dominates whole-epoch cost; an owner-aware compiled/buffered execution plan can retain semantics and cut total cost.
rivals.B: Active numerical integration and event scheduling dominate; spatial/multirate redesign needs mathematical error control.
rivals.C: Numerical stiffness forces many short accepted steps; coupled implicit integration may help, independently of host scheduling.

operation: Profile only complete obj.step calls after first-step warmup on the actual full organism. Compare profile on/off final science before attribution. Select at most one concrete semantics-preserving candidate from the measured dominant cost, with matched final-state and conductance/command checks.

candidate_promotion.scientific_state: bitwise identical for pure refactor; any change means no promotion as a refactor
candidate_promotion.safety: Do not remove essential validation; preserve checks in an equivalent compiled/buffered form if they dominate

stop: Budget, scientific mismatch, no dominant actionable component, or completed meaningful performance result. No micro-adjustment search.
